source_name: BQK/CBK — Time Series database (Seritë Kohore)
why_relevant: Canonical machine-readable long-run series compiled by the sole legally mandated compiler of monetary/financial statistics for Kosovo. Organised by category (Central Bank, ODCs/commercial banks, other financial corporations, pension funds, insurance, financial auxiliaries, external sector) with balance-sheet items, deposits, loans, interest rates, exchange rates. This is the spine of A4 for XK.

source_name: BQK/CBK — Monthly Statistics Bulletin (Buletini Mujor Statistikor / BMS)
why_relevant: Monthly flagship statistical release since 2001 (issue numbering in the 250s-280s as of 2024-2025). Covers financial, external, fiscal and real sector, and — critically for A4 — includes payment-system data alongside deposits, loans, interest rates and exchange rates. Highest-frequency canonical series for XK.

source_name: CBK — Mesečni Statistički Bilten (Serbian-language Monthly Statistical Bulletin)
why_relevant: Serbian-language edition of the same mandated monthly bulletin; resolves the sr language requirement for the A4 cell and provides Serbian statistical terminology for downstream matching. Historic issues (e.g. br. 53, 2006) are archived, giving deep back-series.

source_name: BQK/CBK — Financial Stability Report (Raporti i Stabilitetit Financiar)
why_relevant: Annual analytical report with the richest narrative + tabular view of banking-sector structure, credit growth, NPLs, capitalisation, liquidity, and increasingly payment/digitalisation indicators. Report No. 21 (2025 edition) reports EUR 14.6bn financial-system assets, EUR 6.7bn loans (+14.7% y/y), NPL ~2%. Ideal for sizing and trend context.

source_name: BQK/CBK — Annual Report (Raporti Vjetor) with statistical annexes
why_relevant: Annual institutional report whose payment-system chapter carries the authoritative national interbank payment system (SPN/KIPS) volumes and values — e.g. the 2022 edition reports 17.4m SPN transactions, +19.2% volume / +18.6% value. Statistical annexes give consistent yearly anchors for A4 series.

source_name: BQK/CBK — Card Usage in Kosovo (Përdorimi i kartelave në Kosovë)
why_relevant: The single most on-point document for the card/ATM/POS topics of this cell: dedicated CBK payment-systems analysis of card usage, with ATM vs POS transaction split and growth rates (e.g. domestic POS card payments +30.67% in 2023; POS transactions overtaking ATM as debit cards displace cash for small-value payments). Directly answers card statistics + cash-displacement questions.

source_name: BQK/CBK — Payment System statistics & publications hub (Sistemi i Pagesave)
why_relevant: The CBK payment-systems oversight section is the index page for statistical publications, analyses and informative materials from the Payment System (the site itself points to an aggregate page for these, legacy id ?id=125). Snowballing it should surface periodic payment-instrument statistics beyond the single card-usage PDF.

source_name: BQK/CBK — Other Statistics (Statistika të tjera)
why_relevant: Sibling of the Time Series section holding statistics that do not fit the core monetary/external taxonomy — the likely home of payment-instrument, remittance and ancillary tables relevant to A4.

source_name: BQK/CBK — External Sector Statistics (Statistikat e Sektorit të Jashtëm)
why_relevant: One of the two statistics domains explicitly under CBK legal responsibility. Balance of payments and IIP, and — importantly for payments intelligence in a remittance-heavy economy — cross-border remittance flows that shape money-transfer and card-acceptance demand.

source_name: BQK/CBK — Financial Accounts Statistics (Statistikat e Llogarive Financiare)
why_relevant: Sectoral financial-accounts framework giving whole-economy asset/liability structure — useful for sizing the addressable financial-sector market and cross-checking banking aggregates from the time series.

source_name: BQK/CBK — Monthly Information Report of the Financial System (Raporti i Informatave Mujore të Sistemit Financiar)
why_relevant: Monthly condensed indicator report on the whole financial system (banks, microfinance, insurance, pensions). Faster-turnaround companion to the statistical bulletin; good for near-real-time monitoring of banking-sector aggregates between bulletin releases.

source_name: BQK/CBK — Quarterly Assessment of Macroeconomic Developments (Vlerësimi Tremujor i Zhvillimeve Makroekonomike / VTE)
why_relevant: Quarterly macro assessment giving GDP, consumption, trade and financial-sector context in which payment/card volumes should be normalised. The example found is the Serbian edition, confirming that quarterly output is genuinely trilingual (sq/sr/en) and giving the sr file-naming pattern.

source_name: BQK/CBK — Time Series of Core Inflation (Seria kohore e inflacionit bazë)
why_relevant: CBK-compiled core inflation series — the deflator needed to convert nominal card/POS/ATM value series into real terms and to interpret cash-holding behaviour.

source_name: BQK/CBK — Publications index (Publikimet)
why_relevant: Master index of every CBK periodical (bulletin, monthly financial-system report, quarterly macro assessment, financial stability report, annual report, working papers). The single best crawl seed for enumerating all CBK statistical output and for detecting new series.

source_name: BQK/CBK — About Statistics / Statistics FAQ (Rreth statistikave; Često postavljana pitanja u Odeljenju za statistiku)
why_relevant: Methodological/metadata layer: explains the CBK's statistical mandate under the Law on the CBK, which domains it owns (monetary & financial statistics; external sector statistics), release policy and definitions. Essential for correctly interpreting and joining the series, and a source of authoritative sr/sq terminology.

source_name: BQK/CBK — Statistical news releases (data publication announcements)
why_relevant: CBK announces each statistical release (CBK balance sheet, non-bank financial institutions, remittances) as a dated news item. These are the cheapest possible release-calendar signal — polling the news feed tells the collector exactly when a new data vintage exists, without scraping the heavy statistics pages.

source_name: BQK/CBK — Bank Lending Survey in Kosovo (Anketa e Kreditimit Bankar)
why_relevant: Recurring qualitative/quantitative survey of Kosovo banks on credit standards and demand. Forward-looking complement to the hard series and, because the questionnaire is published, it reveals exactly which variables the CBK tracks at bank level.

source_name: BQK/CBK — legacy document repository (/repository/docs/)
why_relevant: The pre-WordPress file tree still serves live documents (payment-system brochures, e-money brochure, regulations on electronic payment instruments, historic annual reports). Because it is a flat path structure it is the most tractable bulk-harvest surface on the CBK site, and it holds material not relinked from the modern navigation.

source_name: BQK/CBK — National Payments Strategy (Strategjia Kombëtare për Pagesat, SKVV)
source_subtype: strategy / policy document with indicator baselines
why_relevant: Strategy documents state baseline and target values for payment-infrastructure indicators (card penetration, POS/ATM density, electronic vs cash share), which both provide data points and reveal what the regulator intends to measure and publish going forward — a leading indicator of future statistical series.

source_name: IMF Financial Access Survey — Kosovo (CBK-reported ATM/POS/branch and fintech indicators)
source_subtype: international statistical database (re-publisher of national data)
why_relevant: The FAS republishes CBK-submitted supply-side access data — ATMs and POS terminals per 100,000 adults, accounts, branches — in a clean, comparable, downloadable panel. It is the easiest machine-readable route to Kosovo ATM/POS density and lets XK be benchmarked against regional peers. Kosovo is noted as a contributor to the 2024 and 2025 FAS fintech-data pilots, so fintech/mobile-money indicators may also resolve here.

source_name: IMF Article IV / Stand-By & RSF staff reports and technical assistance reports on Kosovo
why_relevant: Staff reports carry standardised statistical annexes built on CBK data plus an explicit assessment of data quality — the FSSR/TA reports evaluate how the CBK compiles financial soundness indicators, monetary and financial statistics and balance-sheet matrices. That is the best independent read on how much to trust each CBK series, and it flags known gaps.

source_name: Kosovo media coverage of CBK statistical releases (Telegrafi, Ekonomia Online)
why_relevant: Albanian-language business media reliably report CBK releases within hours, often quoting headline figures verbatim. Useful as a low-cost release-detection tripwire and for capturing CBK statements made at press conferences that never reach a PDF. Secondary reliability — always resolve back to the CBK original.

source_name: Kosovo academic theses citing CBK payment data (UBT Knowledge Center and similar repositories)
why_relevant: Local theses on electronic payments in Kosovo reproduce and sometimes reconstruct CBK card/ATM/POS series over long horizons, occasionally including tables that are no longer easy to find on the CBK site. A cheap way to recover back-series and to see which CBK tables practitioners actually use.

source_name: BQK — Publikime statistikore, analiza dhe materiale tjera informative nga Sistemi i Pagesave
why_relevant: This is the dedicated landing page of the CBK Payment Systems Department for statistical publications, analyses and informative material — the single most on-target hub for instrument-level and terminal-level payment series (cards, ATM, POS, e-banking) that sit outside the main statistical bulletin.

source_name: BQK — 'Use of Bank Cards in Kosovo' / 'Përdorimi i kartelave bankare në Kosovë' annual analytical report
source_subtype: central bank thematic statistical report (PDF series)
why_relevant: Recurring CBK payment-systems publication dedicated to card issuance (Visa/MasterCard/local share, contactless cards), POS and ATM terminal counts and their geographic concentration — the single richest terminal-level and card-level document series for Kosovo.

source_name: BQK — Seritë kohore (time-series statistics tables)
why_relevant: The CBK's machine-friendly time-series tables portal, referenced by CBK methodology documents as holding the complete series. Likely carries downloadable payment-instrument and infrastructure tables alongside monetary/external-sector tables — the best candidate for structured (XLS) rather than PDF payment series.

source_name: BQK legacy repository — SistemiIPagesave document folder (quarterly payment tables)
why_relevant: Legacy static folder holding the quarterly payment-systems tables (Tremujor*.pdf in Albanian, Tromesecni*.pdf in Serbian) with transaction-type breakdowns, e-banking accounts and transactions, and KosGIRO material. Bilingual, potentially directory-listable — a high-yield historical archive for instrument-level series.
